analysis.title_zh: Managed Deep Agents v0.10：浏览器操作与异步子智能体
analysis.summary: 官方公告介绍 Managed Deep Agents v0.10 的三项变化：浏览器操作支持在无 API 的网站上预订行程、提交理赔；遇到登录时将浏览器交给用户，避免密码进入模型消息与追踪记录。异步子智能体可后台处理长任务，主智能体继续对话，用户可查询进展或调整方向。回复会返回请求发起的 Slack 线程，包括定时运行和延迟完成的子任务结果；线程中的停止按钮可取消运行。
analysis.application: 建议：科研迁移可探索将耗时的信息整理任务交给后台子智能体，并在 Slack 线程集中接收结果；这是迁移设想，并非官方已验证的科研效果。官方公告描述了无 API 网站操作、登录交接和后台任务交互能力，但所给片段未提供效果评测或可靠性数据。
evidence: Browser use: Your agent can book travel or file a claim on sites that have no API.
When a site asks you to sign in, the agent hands you the browser window, so your password stays out of the model's messages and traces.
Async subagents: A long job can go to a subagent that runs in the background while your agent keeps talking with you.
You can ask the agent to check on the job or change its course, and the result comes back to the conversation when the subagent finishes.

Thread origins and stopping runs: Replies go back to the Slack thread a request started in, including replies from a scheduled run or from a subagent that finished later. A Stop button in the thread cancels its runs.
